panels.description: The first licensed Keel shop pays for the tested installation. Keep the transaction terminal and unit clear.
The terminal divides thirty-eight credits into debt, venture and reserve. Leave upper display space.
Alex watches the payment enter his debt account while the contributors' names remain on the shop record. Leave upper display space.
A House fabrication floor begins assembling a larger competing purifier. Leave upper industrial space.
